# Daniel Silva — Industrial Systems & Real-Time Software Engineer

> Daniel Alejandro Silva Rojas ("Daniel Silva") is a software and systems engineer with 5 years
> of shipping production systems. He specializes in industrial and real-time software: telemetry
> and low-latency WebSocket architectures, coordinated control of networked hardware from desktop
> applications, offline-first ecosystems that keep operating without internet and reconcile with
> the cloud, industrial time-series analysis, and applied AI (audio transcription/synthesis,
> voice assistants, computer vision). He is also the founder and architect of DropAudio CCS, an
> e-commerce platform in production. Based in Caracas, Venezuela; works 100% remote. Available for
> freelance engagements and senior remote roles. Spanish (native), English (B2, professional).

## Availability and rates (freelance)
- Performance & architecture audit — from $1,500 USD, 1–2 weeks. Latency, memory-leak and
  concurrency diagnosis, map of single points of failure, refactor roadmap prioritized by impact.
- Custom system, zero to production — from $6,000 USD per project, 6–12 weeks. Hardware
  integration, real-time data, offline-first operation, installers, tests and documentation.
- Fractional systems engineer — from $3,500 USD per month, 20 h/week, 3-month minimum.
- Hourly rate: $45–65 USD. Contracting via Deel, Payoneer or crypto. Overlaps American time zones.
- Also open to senior full-time remote roles (US, Canada, Europe, LATAM).

## Production systems (client work, private repositories)
1. Industrial IoT hardware control (2022–2026, 5 years) — Desktop application (Python/PyQt5) that
   operates industrial inspection cameras coordinated across two networked machines with no
   technical support on site. Principal author: 524 of 681 commits (77%), 398 files, 214,000+
   lines. Dual-PC architecture where the same executable relaunches into its role; chunked image
   transfer with reassembly; explicit timeouts at every network boundary; interactive matplotlib
   maps rendered with blitting; pytest/pytest-qt suite; versioned Windows installer (v12.x).
2. Industrial web platform (2022–2026, 4 years) — Inspection and analytics platform: Nuxt/Vue,
   Express/TypeScript, Sequelize/MySQL, AWS deployment, 2D/3D visualization (Highcharts, D3,
   Three.js), real-time voice chatbot over WebSocket. Repository founder and integration point for
   a ~14-person team; ~2,000 commits.
3. Offline-first ecosystem (2023–2026, 3 years) — Desktop client running 100% offline on plant
   floors with bidirectional cloud↔local sync, Python orchestrator, Node/TypeScript services,
   portable database, self-contained installers, AI audio transcription pipeline (FastAPI),
   CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Principal author since inception; ~250 commits, ~845 files.
4. Industrial time-series analysis (2024–2026, 2 years) — Automatic detection of thermal cycles
   and gradient key points in sensor series: Polars cleaning, interpolation of faulty readings,
   SciPy peak/valley detection, CLI parameters, JSON/Excel/PNG outputs, archived Rust port.

  desktop control of industrial IoT hardware; offline-first ecosystem; AI audio pipeline;
  AWS cloud-native microservices migration optimized with C++ and Rust.

  custom TCP/WebSocket protocols, Rust/C++/Python (PyO3) performance audits.
- Founder & Software Architect — DropAudio CCS (https://dropaudioccs.com), Jun 2021–present.

  recommender, admin panel, 102+ verified reviews, technical SEO.
